title: Men in black at Point Pleasant during Keel's Mothman investigation

tellings.quote: there were also men in black who would all of a sudden like show up outside the uh journalism bureau there

plain: In 1966 and 1967, while the writer John Keel was investigating the Mothman, a winged creature reported around the town of Point Pleasant, mysterious "men in black" would suddenly appear outside the local newspaper office. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells this in passing, without naming a source. It is told as a sign that someone was watching the strange events in the town.
